occupation.evidence: finding remote work. That's been a game-changer for managing symptoms.

disease_control.evidence: Nothing really worked well. ... developed antibodies and it stopped working. Switched to Humira, worked for about two years, then lost effectiveness. Currently on Stelara every 8 weeks. The fatigue is what gets me most. ... It's joint pain, skin problems, extreme exhaustion. ... canceling dates because of flares? ... Stress is my biggest trigger. Lost three jobs due to excessive sick days
